notice: SECONDARY ANALYSIS, NOT CONFIRMATORY (ANALYSIS_PLAN §2 RQ2 'Вторично', §7.2): descriptive; no test of the registry of §7.1; the outcomes are coded with the bands of H2 and carry no sentence of §10

measures.ttt: end-to-end time to ĝ <= τ (common start included), censored at the budget; Kaplan-Meier median over the solver seeds per representative; ratios QUBO/exact (TTT) and QUBO/local search (TTTb)
measures.exact_times: t_primal_s and t_cert_s of the rows of the exact representative
measures.profiles: Dolan-Moré profiles over the instances of a cell on PI+ and on the time to the target

status.choice: Secondary and not confirmatory throughout: no test of the registry of §7.1, no multiplicity adjustment other than the Bonferroni level of the cell intervals, descriptive intervals; every output is flagged (role = secondary, confirmatory = false, a notice, a column `analysis`). The pooled TTT estimates get the same five outcomes as H2 and H2b against [1/1.5, 1.5], coded without a sentence: §10 has none for them.
status.why: §2 RQ2 'Вторично' ('Time-to-target с теми же исходами'); §7.1 lists only H2 and H2b for RQ2; §9 (only the registry is confirmatory).

inputs.choice: The rows, the finished eligibility reports, the certificates and the reference of every instance are those of `e2_analysis h2`, through the same code (bench_instances, reference_table): PI+, the reference and its type are the same numbers in both analyses. The stage `cold` is not read.
inputs.why: audit G1 RQ2-1 and the entry of §12 of 2026-10-12: one reference per instance, the time to the target is measured against it.

ttt_clock.choice: The time of a run is the end-to-end time (seconds from the start of the common clock, the build of the common start t0 included) of the first moment its incumbent has ĝ = (f - f_ref)/s_ref <= τ (cif.metrics.anytime.time_to_target on the trajectory of the row with its start); a run that has not got there by the budget is censored at it (an event exactly at the budget counts, later ones do not). τ = 1e-3 is the main target (the target of the eligibility rule A1), τ = 1e-4 the sensitivity. There is no variant without t0: t0 is a step common to all methods and a small part of 60 s (t0/T is 2e-4 to 3e-3 on the certified calibration instances, configs/E2/README.md), and it is reported per instance (t0_s). The target is measured post hoc against the reference: a heuristic does not know that it has reached it.
ttt_clock.why: §5 'Время end-to-end до ĝ <= τ, τ = 1e-3 (основное) и 1e-4 (чувствительность)' and 'Время end-to-end: построение модели или QUBO, решение, доводка'; A2 leaves t0 charged to the budget of every method; the post-hoc remark is M8 of the review of round 0.

ttt_value.choice: The value of a representative on an instance is the Kaplan-Meier median of the times of its runs (cif.metrics.anytime.km_median: the smallest time at which the survival curve is <= 1/2; every run is censored at the same budget, so it is the ceil(n/2)-th smallest time when that many runs reached the target and infinite otherwise: the 2nd of 3 seeds of the exact method, the 5th of 10 of a heuristic). An infinite median (more than half of the seeds censored) is neither dropped nor extrapolated: the value is the censoring budget, the instance is marked censored for that representative and the number of such instances is reported per cell.
ttt_value.why: §5 'Прогон, не достигший цели, цензурируется на бюджете; медиана по сидам — Каплан–Мейер'; §7.2 'Сводка по инстансу — медиана по сидам'.

ttt_ratio.choice: TTT = value(QUBO)/value(exact) and TTTb = value(QUBO)/value(local search) per instance, natural logarithm; below 1 the QUBO pipeline gets to the target sooner. If exactly one of the two values is a censored median the ratio is formed with the budget in its place and marked a bound (upper when the exact / LS method is the censored one, lower when QUBO is): it is kept and counted. If both are censored the ratio is inf/inf and undefined: the instance leaves the estimate of that pair, is counted ('neither') and is not set to 1, which would pull the pooled estimate towards 'equivalent'. The two pairs lose instances independently.
ttt_ratio.why: §2 R = PI(QUBO)/PI(exact), R_b = PI(QUBO)/PI(LS) and 'с теми же исходами'; §5 leaves an unreached median open; as for PI+ = 0 in H2 (a 0/0 ratio is not floored) an undefined ratio is not invented.

ttt_censoring.choice: Censoring is reported, not repaired: per variant, cell and pair the numbers of instances with both medians observed, only QUBO's, only the other method's, neither; and per representative the number of censored instances. A bound lies closer to 1 than the truth, so an 'equivalent' outcome of a cell with many bounds is weaker than it reads; the counts are the check.
ttt_censoring.why: §5 'Чувствительность — к бюджету цензурирования, а не исключение цензурированных (minor 9)': the censored are never excluded as runs and the cost of keeping them is shown.

ttt_pooling.choice: As H2: cluster means of the log ratio (the instance; in C5 the port, the mean over its λ points), the mean of the cell means with equal weights over the cells of summary.cells of the eligibility report, the percentile 95 % interval of a stratified bootstrap with B = 9999 and seed 60000, one stream [seed, 2, crc32(cell)] per cell (cif.stats.rq2.estimate_rq2), cell intervals at the Bonferroni level of the pooled cells (99 % simultaneous), the five outcomes against the closed band [1/1.5, 1.5]. The two pairs are estimated separately. A pooled cell with fewer than two clusters of a defined ratio in a pair leaves the pool of that pair (the family of the Bonferroni levels shrinks with it) instead of stopping the analysis, and the notes say which cell and why; with no pooled cell left a pair has no pooled estimate.
ttt_pooling.why: §2 and §7.2 (the machinery of H2); a secondary analysis does not stop for a cell that the censoring has emptied, as the confirmatory one does.

ttt_start.choice: An instance whose common start already meets the target (ĝ_start <= τ against the reference of the analysis, in a run of any representative) has no time to the target that is worth a ratio: the time of every method is the build of the start. If the screening lists it as flipped by the scale of the optimum (the reference_check of the eligibility report, class nontrivial) it leaves the TTT estimates and the TTT profile at that target (not the other analyses), is counted per cell, and is named in the report and in a warning; if it is not listed the analysis stops, naming the instance, the representative and the gap. A time that is not positive stops it too.
ttt_start.why: §12 A1 and 'Уточнения A1' (1): the screening uses the scale of the start and does not revise a decision when the scale of the optimum would put the instance on the other side of τ, so such instances exist and stay in H2 and H2b (their PI+ is positive); for the time to the target they are what A1 screens out. An unlisted one would mean that the screening and the references disagree, a question for the orchestrator, not for a floor (as PI+ = 0 in H2).

ttt_sensitivity.choice: Three sensitivities with the estimator and the resamples of the primary: tau_1e-4 (target 1e-4, budget 60 s), budget_30 and budget_10 (target 1e-3, the same trajectories re-censored at 30 s and at 10 s; only shorter budgets exist, the rows end at 60 s). A run is censored by the budget, none is excluded. A Kaplan-Meier median that lies below the new budget is unchanged by it and one above becomes infinite, so what the budgets show is how many medians lie beyond a shorter horizon.
ttt_sensitivity.why: §5 'Чувствительность — к бюджету цензурирования, а не исключение цензурированных (minor 9)'; dropping the censored favours the methods that often miss the target (round 1 of the review). The budgets: 30 s is half of the budget of RQ2, 10 s the budget of the tuning criterion and of H1c (§6).

exact_times.choice: Rows of the role exact_rep only. t_primal is the field t_primal_s of the row (the end-to-end time of the last improvement of the incumbent over the common start, the time of the start if there is none); t_cert is t_cert_s (the time at which the solver proved the incumbent optimal to 1e-6·s). A run has a certificate within the budget iff certified is true and t_cert_s <= the budget (a later one does not count, as events after the budget count nowhere); otherwise it is censored at the budget. Per instance: the median of t_primal over the seeds, the Kaplan-Meier median of t_cert (null when beyond the budget). Per cell: n, min, q1, median, q3, max of the instance values as order statistics (numpy inverted_cdf: the smallest value with at least a share p of the values at or below it, a censored value lying beyond all finite ones); the share of instances with an observed t_cert and the share of runs certified within the budget, with 95 % Wilson intervals; t_primal of the runs split by certified or not (without a certificate t_primal is only the last improvement seen, not the time the optimum was found). Descriptive: no test, no pooling over cells.
exact_times.why: §2 RQ2 'У точных методов t_primal и t_cert — раздельно'; §5 (M8: search against proof); the rows of e2_benchmark carry both fields.

profiles.choice: Dolan-Moré profiles per cell over all its non-trivial instances (C5: its points, the ports are not clusters here) for the three representatives on two costs: PI+ (median over the seeds, positive on a non-trivial instance) and the time to the target at τ = 1e-3, budget 60 s (the Kaplan-Meier median; infinite when censored, which is a failure of the method on the instance, not the budget). The ratio of a cost to the best of the three on the instance; rho(r) is the share of instances with a ratio <= r on the grid 1, 1.1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 8, 16, ..., 1024 and rho(inf) the share with a finite cost; an instance solved by no method stays in the denominator and is counted; the profile of the time to the target leaves out the instances whose start meets the target (counted in n_start_met). Tables only: no plot, no test.

budget_overrun.choice: Rows with budget_ok = false are used as measured (what a run found after the budget does not count, in the times and in PI+); their number is reported per cell and representative. There is no sensitivity that drops them: for the times it would drop the instances on which the exact method is slow.
budget_overrun.why: §5 (time is end-to-end and charged to the method); the reading of H2 for the same rows.

degenerate.choice: The analysis stops, naming the instance, on what stops H2 (PI+ = 0 or not finite, rows of an instance the screening did not select, a selected instance without rows or without a representative, different numbers of seeds across the instances of a cell, several configurations for one role in one cell and size, rows with an error, skipped rows, rows of another budget), on a start that meets the target and is not listed as flipped, on a time that is not positive. No floor is applied.
degenerate.why: §12 A1/A2 and the entry of §12 of 2026-10-12 (9).

budget_10.definition: τ = 1e-3, the trajectories re-censored at 10 s (§5, minor 9)
